title: Teleion Fabric in 3D · Teleion Labs
description: The Teleion Labs film as a walk through a 3D model of Teleion Fabric, with the same words as the home page and every part labeled.

sources.scene text: The film block of content/home.json, copied at build time, so both films say the same thing.
sources.labels: Practice queue numbers: cloud_access.js seedDemo (lease 300 s, heartbeat 30 s, miss_limit 3). Maker and checker keys: cloud_publication.js reviewProof. Muse Spark 1.3 and Wonder 1.0: worker.policy v28. Muse Glimmer 30B is drawn apart from the live workers because the records don't establish routine live routing. Feeds: the public feeds page (GitHub and arXiv, kept as Task Objects). OmniNode is drawn apart from the live workers for the same reason. Shim reads stored records: the shim's worker source. Auto-tuning: eranos-worker eranos/pipeline/tuning.py (hourly tune Task over Muse model and persona per step, every pick recorded).

blocks.label: A three-minute film in 3D, drawn from the text further down this page.

http: The published interface, not another chat window
spark: Claims a Task for a set time
wonder: Picks it up and saves the result
store: Every version kept, with its source
feeds: What's new from GitHub and arXiv, kept as Task Objects
shim: Adds the Task Objects that fit
reuse: Added to the next call through the shim
claim: Practice queues: 300 s lease, check in every 30 s
missed: Three missed check-ins and the Task goes back
workers: An hourly policy picks the model for each Task
tuning: Each hour, recorded outcomes set the next picks of model and approach
